mapper.select: SELECT p.p_code AS p_code, p.subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, p.p_name AS p_name, p.p_price AS p_price, p.p_image AS p_image, p.p_rating AS p_rating FROM products p JOIN subcategories s ON p.subcategory_id = s.subcategory_id WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.p_code

SELECT product_id AS productId, subcategory_id AS subcategoryId, p_name AS p_name, p_price AS p_price, p_image AS p_image, p_rating AS p_rating, review_count AS reviewCount FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (p_code, p_name, p_color, p_width, p_price, p_image, p_rating, subcategory_id) VALUES (#{p_code}, #{p_name}, #{p_color}, #{p_width}, #{p_price}, #{p_image}, #{p_rating}, #{subcategoryId})
